rules.title: Elixir 1.15 no longer receives security updates
rules.summary: Elixir's security policy provides security patches only for the five most recent minor branches. Elixir 1.15 left that window when Elixir 1.20 shipped on 2026-06-03, so the branch no longer receives security patches from the Elixir project.

constraints: Keep .tool-versions, mix.exs elixir:, CI setup-beam versions, and container images on one supported Elixir release line that the chosen Erlang/OTP also supports.
Confirm Hex dependencies compile on the target Elixir and re-resolve with mix deps.get after changing the runtime.

steps.title: Raise the Elixir version
steps.instructions: Change the reported declaration from Elixir 1.15 to a supported release (see the replacement), using the project's existing version manager.

steps.title: Align other Elixir version surfaces
steps.instructions: Update mix.exs elixir:, .tool-versions, CI setup-beam versions, and Dockerfile elixir images so they agree.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active Elixir runtime is the intended release.
Re-resolve dependencies and compile on the new Elixir.
Run the Mix test suite on the new Elixir.

rules.title: Erlang/OTP 26 no longer receives security updates
rules.summary: Erlang/OTP supports the last three major releases with security updates. OTP 26 left that window when OTP 29 shipped on 2026-05-13, so the release no longer receives security updates from the Erlang/OTP project.

constraints: Keep .tool-versions erlang pins, asdf elixir …-otp-N suffixes, CI setup-beam OTP versions, and container images on one supported OTP release that the project's Elixir supports.
Confirm Mix dependencies and NIFs build on the target OTP and recompile after changing the runtime.

rules.title: fennec is retired on Hex
rules.summary: Hex marks every published fennec release as retired with reason renamed, and the retirement message says the package was renamed to mongooseice.

constraints: Preserve STUN/TURN configuration and call sites while moving from fennec to mongooseice.
Keep mix.exs and mix.lock consistent after the replacement.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove {:fennec, …} from mix.exs deps and add {:mongooseice, …} at a maintained version, then run mix deps.get.

steps.title: Migrate fennec usages
steps.instructions: Update application and module references from Fennec to MongooseICE as the mongooseice package documents.

verification.command: mix deps.get && mix deps | grep mongooseice
verification.purpose: Confirm mongooseice is resolved into the Mix dependency tree.
Run the Mix test suite with the replacement package.
